text: This segment of Fallingbrook Road runs along the east side of Blantyre Park. As the park is a popular destination for people of all ages in both winter and summer, there is an increased amount of pedestrian and vehicular traffic in the area. Over the years, residents of Fallingbrook Road have repeatedly expressed serious concerns for the safety of pedestrians, especially children, due to speeding on the street. Therefore, I support the implementation of traffic calming.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Fallingbrook Road, between Clonmore Drive and Kingston Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install three speed humps on Fallingbrook Road, between Clonmore Drive and Kingston Road, generally as shown on the attached Drawing TC-140, dated April 2023 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
